cases.selectionRationale: Saved monster-use lichen case affects a carried corpse; regression self-zap is a living human carrying corpse/egg revival witnesses. C v51 is Upolyd vampire46 and self-targets undead turning; unturn_you makes the undead hero frightened and stunned69. Hero undead-form condition and affected actor add coverage beyond corpse revival.

closestSavedCoverage.sourceTrace: C source path: muse.c:find_offensive -> use_offensive(MUSE_WAN_UNDEAD_TURNING) -> zap.c:unturn_you -> unturn_dead. C observation: C enters the monster offensive-wand route and revives the carried lichen corpse. First RNG divergence occurs at step 126, C collect_coords rn2(8) vs JS rn2(5).
closestSavedCoverage.mission: A hostile intelligent dwarf uses a charged undead-turning wand against a hero carrying a lichen corpse. Actions: Use the confirmed charged-wand setup, keep the hero and corpse in the ray, then allow the monster-use action.

closestSavedCoverage.comment: Independent B53 source-directed witness for zap.c:unturn_dead -> revive_egg and revive through zapyourself/unturn_you. Wizard wishes an undead-turning wand, a troll corpse, and a cockatrice egg, then zaps self. C reaches both helper calls; awaiting pickup.c:encumber_msg before unturn_you preserves the C screen/cursor sequence.
